p1_findings.finding: The frozen replay is always-ready and ends at source-index group acceptance. Weight SRAM latency/banking/arbitration, response tags and stalls, Acc24 state, accumulation and commit are absent.
p1_findings.scope_effect: This lowers the claim to a standalone sparse-frontend cycle result. If 4.764209001x is presented as complete-FC2, FFN, physical or system speedup, this becomes a P0 misclaim.
p1_findings.required_followup: M218 should model and then implement a finite-bandwidth, tagged, epoch-safe service path with accumulator context and backpressure.

p1_findings.finding: M216 emits indices, not weight payloads. A direct K8 arithmetic consumer for one 96-destination INT8 block can require up to 8 x 96 x 8 = 6,144 weight bits per accepted group; this routing/memory cost is not in M216 DC.
p1_findings.scope_effect: The 0.737379% logic-area overhead is frontend control/storage only and cannot be quoted as total K8 datapath or memory overhead.
p1_findings.required_followup: Use lane-sliced/banked responses in M218 and include response serialization in cycle accounting.

p1_findings.finding: The matched K1 intentionally retains the K8 queue, dual D8 windows and eight-lane interface. This is correct for isolating SOURCE_CAP, but a native cropped K1 could be smaller.
p1_findings.scope_effect: The 4.729335849x throughput/logic-area number is conditional on the matched-resource ablation, not a product-level area-efficiency comparison. It does not affect the cycle speedup or the K1 cycle oracle.
p1_findings.required_followup: Add a native-cropped K1 DC sensitivity before using area efficiency prominently.

p1_findings.finding: DC uses a 3 ns ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macros. No routed interconnect, SRAM macro, Formality, PT/SAIF/PTPX or energy result is admitted.
p1_findings.scope_effect: Mapped logic area/timing is a pre-macro ablation only, not paper-ready PPA.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run equivalence and macro/routing-aware timing and power on the selected M218 composition.

p1_findings.finding: Frozen performance covers 120 H67 ep35 FC2 records from one sequence. The exact VCS suite covers directed stalls and protocol attacks, 256 recurrence cases and dense bank96 conservation, but terminal_header_chain and terminal_partial_close_while_group_releases coverpoints remain unhit in the sealed suite.
p1_findings.scope_effect: The result is trace-specific and does not establish cross-sequence robustness or exhaustive control coverage.
p1_findings.required_followup: Add the two missing directed control corners and replay held-out sequences/event-density strata when available.

own_best_k1_cycle_p0.reason: Any SOURCE_CAP=1 machine must service every nonzero source once for every output block. The 412,900,394 event-times-output-block count removes all scan, scheduling and control overhead, so active-depth tuning or a different K1 order cannot go below it without changing the K1 service contract. Against the same-script K8 denominator it still gives 4.577772855x.

mapped_netlist_register_set_recompute.interpretation: The only sequential delta is legal constant folding of K1 group_source_count_q[3:1]; all other 2,770 register instance names match.

independent_dc_audit.flow_boundary: TSMC 28nm commercial standard-cell logic, 3 ns, ideal clock, ZeroWireload, zero macros; pre-macro and not paper-PPA-ready.

allowed: On 120 frozen H67 ep35 FC2 records containing 5.58M tokens and 143.895M nonzero events, a scope-matched, Synopsys-VCS-calibrated standalone sparse-FC2 frontend reduces always-ready cycles from 429.716M at K1 to 90.197M at K8, or 4.764x.
A zero-control-overhead K1 event-service oracle still implies a 4.578x lower-bound speedup against the same K8 denominator.
At the matched 3 ns pre-macro logic-only DC point, K8 adds 0.737% cell area and gives a conditional 4.729x frontend throughput/logic-area ratio.
forbidden: 4.764x complete-FC2, complete-FFN, end-to-end, full-network, physical or system speedup
4.729x silicon throughput/mm2 or total accelerator area efficiency
0.737% total K8 datapath, SRAM, routing or memory overhead
Any energy, FPS, SRAM-latency, accumulator, BN, residual or commit claim from M216
Any headline or comparison against Prosperity/Phi using M216 frontend cycles
Any citation of the r1 DC parent run as a passing result

m218_entry_conditions: Keep K1/K8 memory banks, request queues, context capacity, response tags and accumulator resources matched; vary only source issue cap in the primary A/B.
Replace the implied 6,144-bit free response with a finite lane-sliced service and count every serialization, conflict and response stall.
Use epoch or proven flush acknowledgement to prevent stale response alias after reset or soft flush.
Retain always-ready M216 only as an upper-bound frontend reference, not as the M218 service-cycle answer.
